justification: The case fails on multiple criteria: the Article 11 merits are not adjudicated as a standalone finding (the Court expressly states there is no need to make separate findings under Article 11, resolving everything under Article 10); the merits analysis is not coherent across all applicants (each applicant receives a distinct sub-analysis with different factual and legal bases); and for several applicants the Court itself must determine disputed facts (e.g., whether the event was a solo or group demonstration) before it can evaluate the law.
